name: Lechuguilla
desc: An indicator plant of the Chihuahuan Desert that spreads by underground offshoots into large colonies. Collared peccaries eat much of it in some areas.
about: Agave lechuguilla (common name in Chihuahua: lechuguilla, meaning "small lettuce") is an Agave species found only in the Chihuahuan Desert. The plant flowers once in its life and then dies.
